method.mechanism: Agent hypothesis. For each valid encoded predecessor x_j, compute its normalized squared deviation d_j from the mean of valid states strictly before j; set d_j=0 when none exist. The candidate gives that predecessor weight exp(-2d_j), normalized over predecessors of each query position. The control uses exp(+2d_j) with the same deviation, normalization, computation and parameter count. Retain the incumbent 0.85 current-state and 0.15 context blend. This tests selection by predecessor consistency, distinct from recency weighting and current-to-predecessor similarity tested in prior development summaries.
